import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long flow, capacity;
        Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long capacity) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static class Maxflow {
        int s, t;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] dist, visited, cur;
        int MAX_N;

        Maxflow(int maxN) {
            MAX_N = maxN;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[MAX_N];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[MAX_N];
            visited = new int[MAX_N];
            cur = new int[MAX_N];
        }

        void clear() {
            edges.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            visited[s] = 1;
            dist[s] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (visited[v] == 0 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        visited[v] = 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return visited[t] == 1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == t || flow == 0) return flow;
            long pushed = 0;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                cur[u] = i;
                int idx = adj[u].get(i);
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (dist[e.to] == dist[u] + 1) {
                    long f = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        e.flow += f;
                        edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= f;
                        pushed += f;
                        flow -= f;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long max_flow() {
            long result = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                result += dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] dist_grid = new int[14][14];
    static int n, t;
    static int[] target_idx = new int[103];

    static void bfs_dist(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist_grid[i], 111);

        dist_grid[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (vis[x][y]) continue;
            vis[x][y] = true;
            dist_grid[x][y] = d;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && !vis[nx][ny] && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int idx(int level, int x, int y) {
        return level * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid2[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        Maxflow mf = new Maxflow(7100);
        mf.s = 0;
        mf.t = 7100 - 2;

        int sx = 0, sy = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; ++i)
            target_idx[i] = 7100 - 3 - (n * n - i);

        bfs_dist(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j]))
                    mf.add_edge(mf.s, idx(0, i, j), grid1[i][j] - '0');
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2[i][j]))
                    mf.add_edge(target_idx[idx(0, i, j)], mf.t, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                mf.add_edge(idx(0, i, j), target_idx[idx(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        for (int step = 1; step <= t; ++step) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n &&
                            grid1[ni][nj] != 'Y' && grid1[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                            dist_grid[i][j] >= step && dist_grid[ni][nj] >= step) {
                            mf.add_edge(idx(step - 1, ni, nj), idx(step, i, j), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    mf.add_edge(idx(step, i, j), target_idx[idx(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.max_flow());
    }
}
